div.head: Northu 41
div.ab: Gif preost oferdruncen lufige oððe gliman oððe ealascop wurðe, gebete þæt.
Gif preost oferdruncen lufige oððe gliman oððe ealascop wurðe, gebete þæt.
If a priest practises drunkenness or becomes a gleeman or a tavernminstrel, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest embraces drunkenness, or becomes an entertainer or a singer among drinkers, he is to atone for that.
Wenn ein Priester Trunkenheit liebt oder lustiger Spielmann oder Bierdichter wird, büsse er das.
If a priest loves drunkenness or becomes a gleeman or an ale-poet, let him atone for it.
div.note: D writes the second ‘oððe’ with the abbreviation ‘ł’. Liebermann compares Canons of Edgar 57 f.
literally “an ale minstrel”, one who performs where men are drinking.
